hero.title: Central Tiffin Room: Bengaluru's Century-Old Culinary Icon
hero.subtitle: Experience the legendary Benne Dose and authentic South Indian delicacies that have delighted generations for over 100 years at Central Tiffin Room.

about.title: Our Enduring Story at Central Tiffin Room
about.paragraph1: Central Tiffin Room, fondly known as CTR, is a legendary hotel deeply woven into the heart and history of Old Bengaluru. Incepted in 1920, Central Tiffin Room has been delighting patrons for over a century with iconic Dosas, Idlis, and a variety of South Indian delicacies, which remain timeless favorites among all ages.
about.paragraph2: At Central Tiffin Room, our rich legacy, crafted by the visionary Subramanyam brothers and carried forward through generations by Mr. Sanjeev Poojari, Mr. Sandesh Poojari, and Ganesh S Poojari, epitomizes culinary mastery and cherished tradition. We proudly serve 'Bengaluru’s Best Benne Dose,' an emotion that holds Old Bengaluru together, consistently delivering the same delicious taste and an essence of nostalgia in every bite for over 104 years.
